story.title: From the Heart of Palestine, to Every Home
story.body: HATTAH was born from a longing for an unforgettable land, and a sincere wish to keep the details of Palestinian heritage alive in every home and every heart. Every embroidered stitch, every thread, every symbol we bring to you tells a story of patience, beauty, and an identity that has never changed. We work from Turkey with skilled Palestinian hands, to bring you authentic pieces that carry the spirit of the land wherever you are.

about.title: About HATTAH
about.lead: HATTAH (حَطّة) is an Istanbul-based online store for authentic Palestinian and Gazan heritage products.
about.who: HATTAH is a Palestinian brand based in Istanbul. We offer products that carry the memory and heritage of Palestine, each shown with clear photos, a description and a price in Turkish lira.
about.offer: We offer hoodies with heritage designs, Palestinian tatreez embroidery, artwork, medallions and necklaces, and homemade Palestinian food. Every product is listed in the shop with its details.
about.delivery: We deliver everywhere in Turkey. Delivery is free within Başakşehir, Istanbul.
about.order: Pick a product in the store, add it to your cart and send your order on WhatsApp in one tap. You can also message us directly on WhatsApp at {phone}.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Quick answers about ordering, delivery and products from HATTAH.

items.q: What is HATTAH and where are you based?
items.a: HATTAH (حَطّة) is an online store based in Istanbul offering Palestinian and Gazan heritage products such as hoodies, tatreez embroidery, artwork, medallions and homemade food. We do not have a public shop for walk-ins; we work through the online store and WhatsApp.

items.q: How do I order from HATTAH?
items.a: Choose a product in the store, add it to your cart and send the order on WhatsApp in one tap, or message us directly on WhatsApp at {phone} with the product you want.

items.q: Which areas do you deliver to?

items.a: Yes, delivery is free within Başakşehir, Istanbul. For other areas we confirm the delivery cost with you on WhatsApp before the order is confirmed.
It depends on your city and the product. We confirm the expected delivery date with you on WhatsApp when you order.

items.q: What sizes are available for the hoodies?
items.a: Available sizes are listed on each product page. If you need help choosing a size, message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I order a custom-design hoodie?
items.a: Yes. Send us your idea on WhatsApp and we will confirm whether it can be made, the price and the preparation time.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We confirm the available payment methods with you on WhatsApp when the order is confirmed.
Hoodies with heritage designs, Palestinian tatreez embroidery, artwork, medallions and necklaces, homemade Palestinian food and other heritage gifts.
